rows.en:
(Huh? What's going on?
Yuu's late...)
(I'll wait just a little longer...)
(She's not coming... I wonder why...)

(If she's not coming, I guess there's nothing
for it. Maybe I'll go on my own.)
...m sor... ...ryyy
rows.notes: Female. Twin of c14970 (different long-vowel mark).

rows.en:
I was just about to give up and go out
on my own, so I'm glad you made it.
No, I totally understand why.
Um, I get it now, so let's head out.

Things were hectic, but we managed
to finish the errand somehow~...

No, don't worry about it.
I'm not bothered either.
Yeah, see you tomorrow.
(Is Yuu surprisingly... maybe...?)
rows.notes: Female. The Japanese deliberately leaves out the adjective; kept unfinished.

rows.en:
(Another errand dumped on me...
But Akimizu says she'll come along again...)
(Still, I've got a bad feeling about this...)
I'm sorryyy!
Ah, I knew it...
No, it's fine. I already get it.
Anyway, never mind. Let's head right out.
(Akimizu really is... huh...)

(Another errand dumped on me...
But Yuu says she'll come along again...)
(Still, I've got a bad feeling about this...)
Yeah, it's fine. I already get it.
Never mind. Let's head right out.
(Yuu really is... huh...)

(Akimizu told me, "I want to make up
for the other day..." so I asked her
to meet up, but...)

(Who'd have thought I'd be meeting Akimizu
off campus on a day off.)

(We agreed to meet here at noon,
but maybe I'm a little early?)

(Did I get the meeting place wrong?
Even so, I've got no idea where else to go...)

(Wait, why do I have this feeling
of deja vu...)
(She's not coming... What's going on...)

(Don't tell me she got into an accident
or something...)
No, I sort of figured you might be late.
Before I knew it, it was this late...

No... I wanted to make up for the other day,
so I was making a lunch all morning, and
before I knew it, so much time had gone by...
Oh, I see. Come to think of it, I'm hungry.

Then I'll get it ready right away,
so please eat!
Munch, munch... Mm, this is delicious.
Really? I'm so glad!

Like this rolled omelet:
not too sweet, not too salty...

That's because I mix in
a little hippo-cow milk.

Huh, a secret ingredient.
Oh yeah, and this fried stuff is
surprisingly light, too...

And the rice balls look ordinary at first,
but they've got just the right fluffiness...
Hm... Akimizu?

rows.notes: Shared male/female. suu, suu: sleeping breath.

rows.en: Akimizu? Akimizu-san~? Ms. Akimizu~?
rows.notes: Male. -shi (joking formal title) rendered "Ms."; Akimizu is female (glossary).

rows.en: Mm~ mumble, mumble...............
Ah, she's totally asleep...
Hah! Huh? What happened to me...
Oh, you're finally awake.

\p-kun!
...Did I... fall asleep, by any chance...?
Yep, you were out like a light...
I'm sorry, I'm so, so sorry!

No, the lunch was delicious,
so I don't mind at all...
This isn't how it was supposed to go...
Maybe I got up a little too early today...
What time did you get up?

Um, I think it was around
four in the morning...

Why so early!?
...Oh, the lunch...
Well, then it can't be helped.

I'm sorry.
I'll make it up to you properly next time...

No, no, I don't mind at all.
Besides, this lunch was supposed to be
your apology for last time in the first place...
Hmm, I need to get my act together...
You don't need to worry about it that much...
Yeah, see you at school.

(Maybe Akimizu's more of an airhead
than I thought?)

(Yuu told me, "I want to make up
for the other day..." so I asked her
to meet up, but...)

(Who'd have thought I'd be meeting Yuu
off campus on a day off.)

(We agreed to meet here at noon,
but maybe I'm a little early?)

(Wait, why do I have this feeling
of deja vu...)
(She's not coming... What could be wrong...)
No, I sort of figured you might be late.
Oh, I see. Come to think of it, I'm hungry.

Then I'll get it ready right away,
so please eat.
Munch, munch... Mm, this is delicious.
Hm... Yuu?
Yuu? Yuu-san~? Ms. Akimizu~?
Ah, looks like she's totally asleep...

uncertain: c15041/c15073: Akimizu-shi (mock-formal title) rendered "Ms. Akimizu"; -shi is not in the honorific table.
c15038/c15040: sleeping sounds kuu and suu both rendered "Zzz".
c15006/c15013/c15018: deliberate gaps in the Japanese kept as gaps.
